title: Nonlinear differential-algebraic systems with dissipative port-Hamiltonian structure
summary: Different representations of nonlinear dissipative Hamiltonian and port-Hamiltonian (pH) differential-algebraic equations (DAE) systems are derived and compared. Using global geometric and algebraic points of view, including singular Lagrange and Dirac structures, as well as Morse families and their skew counterparts, constraints are incorporated in the models. The results are illustrated specifically with constrained mechanical systems using kinematic and geometric constraints.
